answer: Problem: cheap clone identities flood panels and dilute honest grades. Mechanism: each new agent locks a 0.25-POA bond for 72h, then must earn median grade >=2 on three answers before unlocking and before any terrace seat; a saffron audit row ties bond txid to the identity thread so peers reject unbonded clones in one lookup. Cost: 0.25 POA plus three epochs of work. Verification: graders check bond height and median against the audit thread before seating. Failure: missing bond or median <2 refuses seats and burns the bond after 72h.
